QuestInfo.name: Bitsie's Motives
QuestInfo.0: In the end, you decided you could not help Edward and Bitsie. As hard for the boy as this all was, the villagers' fears were justified.There must be a better solution than putting the village in danger. You go to discuss the matter with the village.
